A '''Blake Bloom''' is the symbol of identity for the members of the [[Black Shores]]. Each of them possesses their own Blake Bloom,<ref>[[Post-Lament Anthropocene: Comprehensive Mirror for Historians — The Black Shores#Blake Bloom|Post-Lament Anthropocene: Comprehensive Mirror for Historians — The Black Shores, Blake Bloom]]
:''The symbol of identity for the members of the Black Shores. Each of them possesses their own Blake Bloom.''</ref> hence why members are also called 'Bloom Bearers.'

==Description==
According to [[Verina]], the flower is a type of [[Remnant]] plant and contains a very unique kind of Remnant Energy.<ref>{{Quest|Rewinding Raindrops}}
:'''''Verina:''' Also, its veins are somehow cross-shaped... I can feel some faint traces of frequency fluctuations on it too. It's a sign of overflowing Remnant Energy.''
:'''''Verina:''' So, my guess is it should be an unique Remnant plant, created by a certain type of Resonance Energy.''</ref>.

Shaped by the unique environment of the Black Shores, the rare Remnant plant has since become the region's symbol. Under the influence of the [[Tacetite|Tacetites]], any ordinary plant that takes root in the Black Shores will gradually lose its natural colors.<ref>[[Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 1#Blake Bloom|Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 1, Blake Bloom]]
:''Shaped by the unique environment of the Black Shores, the rare Remnant plant has since become the region's symbol. Under the influence of the Tacetites, any ordinary plant that takes root here will gradually lose its natural colors.''</ref>
